draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.25, the 63rd-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 14th of 35 at WR. He went 33rd overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (63rd): teams liked him more than the published grade. Published comparison: Drake London. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (5th percentile). College production: 658 receiving yards in 2023, 28th of 35 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the Buffalo Bills. 26 career games and 18 starts over 2 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 4 AV in 2025. Weak spots: yards after catch per reception 2.3 (6th percentile), yards per target 6.8 (23rd percentile). Versus the typical Year-2 wide receiver who played: 404 receiving yards against a median of 290, above the norm.
